title.rendered: Update: Adjusted Timeline for Hybrid Transition

content.rendered:
Last week, the board held a special session to vote on dates for returning to in-person learning. As long as counties continue to meet advisory metrics, Kindergarten in-person learning is projected to begin on March 1st, with additional grades being added weekly in a phased in approach.

Although we are confident in this timeline, it is important to remember that this plan is based on current guidance and what we know at this time. Timelines and plans may still be amended at any future date should new requirements be mandated at the state level or if information is made available that could improve conditions for teaching and learning in the district.

You can expect further date announcements, additional details (including schedule times) and an updated Hybrid Transition Overview with answers to commonly asked questions later this week. Cohort assignments will be sent out by next week.
